0022600090.text: Both the Indiana Pacers and New Orleans Pelicans open their 2026-27 seasons in this game. The Pacers will be without Johnny Furphy, who is out after knee surgery, and Aaron Nesmith (hamstring), Jarace Walker and T.J. McConnell (both undisclosed) are listed as day-to-day and are game-time decisions. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 1-1, and Indiana's most recent meeting was a 127-119 Pacers win in Indianapolis on January 16, 2026, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Pacers a 65% chance to win.
